text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
One can never be too careful even with 
minor injuries, but aren't you worrying 
just a little too much?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hmm... Is that your duty as a Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Well, if you're asking whether it hurts or 
not, it definitely does.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It's not like I can't walk... but hey, 
since you're here, maybe you could carry 
me on your back on the way home~
choice_data_list: That would be better, wouldn't it?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It's not like I can't walk... but hey, 
since you're here, maybe you could carry 
me on your back on the way home~
choice_data_list: That would be better, wouldn't it?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...Good grief. Are you a worrywart, or 
just too serious for your own good?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I was half joking, but... well, if you say 
so, I'll count on you!

Keeping an eye on Agnes Tachyon's injury, 
I carried her piggyback to the dormitory.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh~ If you're so worried about me, you 
could at least do that much for me~.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Aaah. I kinda don't feel like walking 
anymore~.

In the end, I gave Agnes Tachyon, who was 
pretending to sulk, a piggyback ride all 
the way back to the dorms.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: You worry about me, yet you're so strict.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Then at the very least, treat my injury, 
won't you?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Besides, I might be able to learn 
something from your medical techniques.

Agnes Tachyon is observing me with great 
amusement. Judging by her expression, she 
seems to have learned something.
